messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT - KV cache paging spike on prod-east-1. Observed high evo paging + continuous-batch lat tail. Metric summary: paging_rate=82%, kv_evictions/sec=1200, p95 latency up 3x. Suspected correlate: last model-serving change with AWQ-int8 kernel selector (deploy abc1234) 8m ago. Root thread created automatically.

Alex M: saw the bot, jumping in. Does this match the kv footprint graphs?

Jordan (oncall): yep. p95 token process times spiked ~08:21 UTC, matches increase in per-entry KV size on those pods. Looks like AWQ path is generating larger KV entries for long prompts.

Samir: quick triage — can we mute continuous batching to stop amplification while we triage? That usually kills the growth.

Maya R: +1. If batching is coalescing many sessions, a slightly larger kv item multiplies memory pressure. Recommend immediate throttle to continuous.batch_size max=8 and set `continuous.batch_window_ms=10` as emergency.

Jordan (oncall): making the change now on prod-east-1 staging ring 1. Command:

```
# emergency: reduce batch amplification
rdwctl apply -e prod-east-1 --patch '{"continuous": {"max_batch_tokens": 4096, "max_requests": 8, "batch_window_ms": 10}}'
```

deploy-bot: starting rolling config update on pool inference-prod-east-1-a (12 nodes).

Alex M: also can we flip kernel fallback to fp16 for AWQ path? We have a runtime flag `RUNTIME_QUANT_FALLBACK=fp16-on-failure`. If kernel selector chooses AWQ-int8 and that yields oversized KV, forcing fp16 will reduce kv size.

Priya K: I can patch a hotfix to kernel selector to prefer fp16 for >2048 token context models. PR ready (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/r/1234). If we want faster, we can set env override for selector: `FORCE_KERNEL_FP16=true` on the affected rings.

Jordan (oncall): apply both mitigations in parallel: batching throttle + selector override. Patching selector override now.

```
rdwctl set-env prod-east-1 inference-runtime FORCE_KERNEL_FP16=true --scope=ring-1
```

Samir: logs from node inf-07 show large kv entry sizes in MBs: `kv_entry_size_bytes=3_200_000` for AWQ-int8 entries for a 14k token request. That explains immediate eviction/migration to swap.

Alex M: can we also limit per-entry kv size temporarily? Set `KV_MAX_ENTRY_BYTES=1048576` (1MB) to force eviction/local truncation.

Maya R: doing that now for ring-1 and ring-2.

```
rdwctl apply -e prod-east-1 --patch '{"kv_cache": {"max_entry_bytes": 1048576}}'
```

deploy-bot: config update succeeded on 8/12 nodes, continuing.

Jordan (oncall): monitoring… paging_rate dropping from 82% -> 40% in 5m. kv_evictions/sec fell to 400. p95 latency trending down.

Eric T: Customer impact: two customers reported degraded response times for inference-heavy endpoints during 08:20-08:35 UTC. No dropped requests; increased tail latency only. CS paged us at 08:27.

Priya K: after forcing fp16 and limiting kv entry size, the runtime logs show fallback triggered for AWQ kernels: `kernel_fallback=fp16` and `kv_entry_trim=enabled`. No crashes.

Samir: can we capture minimal repro to prevent regression to prod? We should collect a sample request and the produced kv blob for analysis. Jordan, can you stash a few kv blobs from inf-07 and push to the incident dump?

Jordan (oncall): saved two samples to s3://rdw-incident-dumps/1719504321/ and uploaded link to the internal ticket. Files: kv_blob_1.bin (3.2MB), kv_blob_2.bin (2.9MB).

Maya R: good. Early hypothesis: AWQ int8 kernel changed representation layout -> more metadata + per-token keys -> ~2-3x inflated kv size for long contexts. This interacts badly with continuous batching because the same kv get cached per request and amplified across coalesced microbatches.

Alex M: next steps: 1) keep FORCE_KERNEL_FP16 for now 2) revert AWQ selector default in next deploy 3) add unit/integration test that asserts kv_entry_bytes growth < 30% across quant kernels for our canonical prompts 4) postmortem + regression guard.

Jordan (oncall): agree. I'll coordinate a rollback of the AWQ kernel selection from the last deploy. PR/commit to revert: commit abc1234 -> revert PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/p/r/1240. Targeted rollback planned to ring-1 -> ring-all after sanity checks.

Priya K: prepping the revert. ETA 20m for canary and run through e2e.

deploy-bot: starting canary rollback of kernel-selector on ring-1.

(10m pass)

Jordan (oncall): canary looks clean. paging down to 15%. No new evictions logged. Rolling to remaining rings.

Alex M: after rollback, we should push a hotfix to kernel-selector to include a guardrail: if measured kv_entry_size for recent window > 1MB and growth delta > 1.5x, automatically prefer fp16. That will auto-roll back noisy kernels in future.

Maya R: logged a ticket INT-3214 for automatic kernel fallback safeguard + added test harness to reproduce long prompt kv sizes.

Eric T: CS update sent to affected customers: apology + timeline + confirmation that mitigations reduced latency and no data loss.

Samir: monitoring dashboards for 30m. If paging stays <20% and p95 stabilizes, we can remove the emergency `KV_MAX_ENTRY_BYTES` cap and keep FORCE_KERNEL_FP16 for 24h before safe revert.

Jordan (oncall): agree. Leaving FORCE_KERNEL_FP16 on ring-2/ring-3; will relax ring-1 in 24h conditional on metrics.

Priya K: will follow up with a reproducible test and a proper AWQ int8 kernel patch.

Alex M: postmortem owner: Maya R. Action items assigned in channel:
- Maya R: postmortem writeup + timeline (due EOD tomorrow)
- Priya K: kernel patch + tests (PR by EOD)
- Jordan (oncall): rollback and canary notes + deploy timeline (done)
- Samir: dashboard alert tuning (p99 paging > 40% -> auto-page)
- Alex M: add regression gate to deployment pipeline for quant kernels (block on kv growth tests)

Maya R: acknowledged. I'll include KV blob artifacts and the metric deltas.

Alex M: great work triaging. We'll follow up in #postmortems once initial doc is up. Please add any customer callbacks here.

Eric T: CS already scheduled follow-ups with affected accounts for 09:00 UTC. Closing incident thread when postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=high, status=mitigated, mitigations=throttled-batching|forced-fp16|kv-entry-cap|rollback-kernel-selector.

Jordan (oncall): leaving notes: final metrics snapshot before close: paging_rate=12%, kv_evictions/sec=85, p95 latency back to baseline. Logging export saved.

Maya R: starting postmortem authoring now. Will ping when draft ready.

Priya K: adding a follow-up TODO: add quant-kernel selection A/B test in staging to catch size regressions.

Samir: thumbs up.

(ends)
